description: Open repair and rewind jobs; schedule the repair bay, oven, and test bay on the ERP scheduling board; print travelers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without the schedule and travelers the bay works from memory; after one day jobs and storm orders get out of sequence. The ERP vendor states RPO 1 hour; 4 hours of shop-side entries can be re-keyed from paper
manual_workaround: Printed weekly schedule and paper travelers (template in the incident binder); whiteboard in the bay

description: Teardown, failure inspection, core and coil work, coil winding from rewind data sheets and machine programs, reassembly, and tanking
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $4,200 of output per working day; storm-season orders back up fast. Rewind data sheets are needed to wind replacement coils; a day of library changes can be redone
manual_workaround: Wind from printed data sheets in the bay binder; hand-written winding records; work units that do not need rewinding first
dependent_systems: SYS-02 (rewind data sheet library); SYS-07; SYS-03 (shop-floor PC)
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; MSP; winding machine OEM
dependent_people_or_facilities: Lead Winder; 2 Repair Technicians; repair bay

description: Dry core and coil assemblies in the vacuum oven; process and fill transformer oil
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A cycle in progress must be finished or stopped safely; every rebuilt unit must be dried before oil fill. Recipes change rarely, so a weekly copy is enough once copies exist (today they exist only in the PLC)
manual_workaround: Run the oven from the local HMI panel with the modem unplugged; follow the OEM's printed recipe sheet; hold units until drying is possible
dependent_people_or_facilities: Shop Manager; oven operator (a Repair Technician)

description: Run turns ratio, winding resistance, insulation resistance, power factor, and applied and induced voltage tests; produce the signed test report that ships with every unit
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No unit ships without a test report, so a test PC outage stops all shipments, including storm stock. The federal order and utility purchase orders require test reports. Today the local test database is not backed up, so the real RPO is everything since installation (about 6 years)
manual_workaround: Test set front-panel readings recorded on paper forms and typed into a report template on a clean laptop, signed by the Shop Manager (slower, about 3 units a day instead of 8)
dependent_systems: SYS-05 (test PC and test set); SYS-02 (report copies)
dependent_third_parties: Test set vendor (software media, license, calibration)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Field Service and Test Technician; Shop Manager; test bay

business_process: Shipping, storm-stock sales, and customer communication
description: Quote and sell remanufactured units from stock; book shipments; answer utility calls; update the customer portal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: After a hurricane, utilities buy from whoever can ship first; a day without quotes or shipping loses storm sales. Delivery promises in the federal order and utility orders
manual_workaround: Phone and text from the Owner's cell; paper bills of lading; inventory list printed weekly in storm season
dependent_third_parties: ERP vendor; productivity suite vendor; freight carriers; internet provider

description: On-site repairs, oil sampling and processing, and testing at customer sites, including the cooperative's substations; DGA results to customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Field jobs are scheduled days ahead and can slip a few days; the cooperative exhibit requires access notices within 1 business day regardless of outages
manual_workaround: Paper field forms; results phoned to the customer; the oil laboratory reports directly to the customer
dependent_third_parties: Oil laboratory; the G&T cooperative (site access)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Field Service and Test Technician; Shop Manager (badge holders)

description: Order copper wire, insulation, oil, bushings, and gaskets; receive materials; pay suppliers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Suppliers hold orders for a few days; most materials are stocked 2 to 4 weeks ahead; bank detail changes must be verified by call-back
manual_workaround: Phone orders to known suppliers; paper receiving log

description: Invoice customers (including the federal order); post payments; biweekly payroll through the payroll service; HR files
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Invoices can wait a few days; payroll runs biweekly through an outside service; the cash reserve covers about 45 days
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll service; invoice from the bank's portal or by mail
